custos-desc: Custos, the gatekeeper of Principia Machina: it calls the Calculator out of the web request, checking the binary's digest before every call, and writes the pages it answers.
apihelp-pma-summary: Principia Machina's API module, Custos's: PETITION, PUSH and RELEASE write a ticket whose work is a job's; POLL reads it.
apihelp-pma-param-op: The op: PETITION, PUSH, RELEASE, HEARTBEAT, STRUCTURE_TEST (each a POST with a CSRF token, by an account of the group pma-agent), POLL, STATUS or INQUIRE.
apihelp-pma-param-prefix: The UWC's record prefix (PETITION, PUSH, RELEASE, HEARTBEAT, STRUCTURE_TEST).
apihelp-pma-param-records: The records pushed, as the Calculator reads them; at most $wgCustosMaxRequestBytes bytes; never parsed by Custos (PUSH).
apihelp-pma-param-block: The work block's name (PETITION, PUSH, RELEASE).
apierror-custos-not-agent: The op $1 needs an account of the group pma-agent.
apierror-custos-blocked: The op $1 is refused: the account is blocked.
apierror-custos-internal: The op $1 failed inside Custos ($2); the details are in the wiki's debug log only.
right-custos-landing: Petition, push to and release a UWC through action=pma
action-custos-landing: petition, push to and release a UWC through action=pma
right-custos-role: Be listed in a role group of Custos (a marker: it grants no action)
action-custos-role: be listed in a role group of Custos
custos-governed-page: The page $1 is governed by Custos: it is changed only by a landing, never by a direct edit.
custos-restricted-page: This page is restricted: only the Declarer and the Operator read it.
grant-custos: Petition, push and release through Custos (action=pma); carries the right custos-landing, which only the group pma-agent holds
custos-restricted-route: This list does not show the restricted namespace: a restricted page is read only by its own title, by the Declarer and the Operator.
apierror-custos-restricted-route: The restricted namespace is not listed: a restricted page is read only by its own title.
